name: Brand Model 8 ohm

crossover_part.comment: for a passive part rather than a driver, replace ts with these fields
crossover_part.core: air | ferrite | powder | iron, or omitted for a capacitor or resistor
crossover_part.saturation_note: the supplier states it has not measured power handling or saturation points for its coils. Record 'not published' rather than leaving the field blank, and see framework/references/crossover-design.md section 12 for the 1.2 kHz frequency rule that replaces it

notes: xmax_standard is one of geometric, aes2_1984, iec_62458, aes2_2012 or not_stated - four definitions are in circulation and only the last two measure the same quantity, so a figure without its definition cannot be compared with another driver's. Fill displacement_limits where the manufacturer or a measurement gives them; the smallest binds. Measure a sample before final tuning.
